text:
GTA 6 has three fake watch brands. Crowex reportedly copies the gold Rolex Day-Date ref. 228238, Covgari the Audemars Piguet Royal Oak, and Kronos the Casio Pro Trek PRW-1300.

These read as homages, not official watches.

Which one would you wear in Vice City? Comment below.

Source: Watches Off 5th (GTA 6 Watches) and JFK (Horloges GTA 6: Rolex, Audemars Piguet, Casio). Photos: Wikimedia Commons: Rolex Day-Date (CC BY-SA 3.0), Audemars Piguet Royal Oak ref. 15202 (CC BY-SA 4.0), Casio Triple Sensor Pro Trek (CC BY 2.5).
